body:
## Quick answer

You can buy Indian clothes online from **Bahe Kurtiz** in Jaipur and have them delivered to Australia with **free express shipping and duties included** – nothing extra to pay on delivery. Ready sizes are dispatched in 7–10 working days and arrive about 5–10 business days later; every style can be stitched to your measurements at no extra cost.

## Sizes in Australia

Australian dress sizes follow UK sizes: AU 12 is about a 36-inch bust (an Indian M). The [size converter](/tools/indian-size-converter/) has an AU option, or choose free custom fit.

## What to wear in Australia

The seasons are reversed: Diwali falls in spring and Christmas in summer, so light cotton and georgette suit most festivals. Velvet is only worth it for winter weddings from June to August, especially in Melbourne.

## Festivals and wedding season

Diwali festivals take place in Sydney, Melbourne and other cities every year, and many Indian weddings are held in the warm months from October to April. See the exact last order dates for upcoming festivals below and on our [festival calendar](/festival/).

faq.q: How long does delivery to Australia take?
faq.a: Ready sizes are dispatched in 7–10 working days and custom-fit pieces in 10–15 working days; express delivery then takes about 5–10 business days, with tracking.

faq.q: Will I pay customs duty in Australia?
faq.a: No. We ship duties-paid (DDP), so duties and taxes are included and there is nothing to pay on delivery.

faq.q: Which currency will I pay in?
faq.a: Prices are in US dollars. Your card or PayPal is charged in USD and your bank converts it to Australian dollars.

faq.q: What if my size is not standard?
faq.a: Choose free custom fit and send your bust, waist, hip and height – we stitch the outfit to your measurements at no extra cost, up to size 3XL (4XL in our linen & velvet styles).
